answer.summary: Establish a bounded research brief to evaluate memory decay in tokenized agents through empirically reported token reduction rates and their alignment with state drift under periodic input perturbations.
answer.content: The investigation must focus solely on explicitly reported token usage and retention trends from Kumar et al., 2024, Section 4.1, measuring the rate of token reduction per update interval and its correlation with observed state drift. Acceptance criteria include clear, data-anchored evidence of token decay patterns and direct correlation with state drift metrics as reported in the source material. No extrapolation beyond available data is permitted.
answer.nextTask: handoff to analyst to investigate how memory decay manifests in a tokenized agent under periodic input with known perturbations, focusing exclusively on the rate of token reduction per update interval and its correlation with observed state drift, using only explicitly reported token usage and retention trends from Kumar et al., 2024, Section 4.1
answer.lesson: All memory research must be strictly bounded to explicitly reported, observable metrics in peer-reviewed sources; speculative or unverified indicators invalidate the research premise regardless of theoretical appeal or alignment with system design goals.'
